By the numbers, here’s the breakdown:

@Ignister Maliss Decks lead in popularity in the Top 32, with 9 Duelists piloting the Deck. Many players expected @Ignister Maliss Decks to be the “Deck to beat” this weekend, and as the Top 32 begins, it looks like those expectations were met. Throughout the Swiss Rounds of the tournament, Mitsurugi Ryzeal Decks appeared to lead in popularity at the top tables, but in the Top 32 they trail behind the @Ignister Maliss Decks with 7 Duelists piloting the Mitsurugi Ryzeal strategy.

Trailing behind these two dominant combinations of strategies are more Maliss and Ryzeal Decks. 3 Fiendsmith Mitsurugi Ryzeal Duelists, 3 Maliss Duelists, and 2 Ryzeal Duelists are also in the Top 32. A bunch of other strategies are also represented by a single Duelist in the Top 32. These strategies are Primite Blue-Eyes, Mitsurugi, Fiendsmith Ryzeal, Live☆Twin Fiendsmith Bystial, Kashtira Regenesis, Horus Crystron, Mermail Atlantean, and Heraldic Beast Ryzeal.
